activity.notes: Truckee (also remembered as Old Winnemucca or Captain Truckee) was a medicine chief and influential prophet associated with the Kuyuidika band of the Northern Paiute. A U.S. National Park Service account securely documents him as a Northern Paiute chief guiding emigrants in 1844; he remained an influential leader until his death in 1860. ATLAS uses this evidence window rather than fabricating a formal accession date or treating him as ruler of all Northern Paiute.

sources.title: U.S. National Park Service — Young Man Alone: Snowbound in the Sierra Nevada, 1844
sources.citation_text: NPS identifies Truckee as a Northern Paiute chief who guided the 1844 emigrant party and explains the origin of the Truckee name.
